title: Playing Soulspinner via Ambush into a battlefield that already has an active showdown pushes a second, duplicate showdown for the same battlefield onto showdownStack.
expected: Reproduced with harness: P1 moves a unit to uncontrolled bf1 (opens non-combat showdown, stack=1), then plays Soulspinner (ven-123-166) via Ambush to bf1 -> showdownStack has 2 active entries for bf1, both isCombatShowdown:false. Root cause: packages/riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/movement/contest-arrival.ts:53-58 only short-circuits into the "join existing showdown" path when hasOpponentUnit is true (combat already under way). For a non-combat showdown already in progress (bf.contested===true, showdownComplete!==true, no enemy units), execution falls through past line 84 (contested already true, so flags untouched) to line 93 which unconditionally calls startShowdownState(...), pushing a duplicate ShowdownState (chain/chain-state.ts:449-473 appends to showdownStack with no same-battlefield check). Called from play-unit.ts:1144.
observed: After playUnit(location=battlefield-player-2-bf-ogn-275-298) interaction.showdownStack had 2 entries for battlefieldId player-2-bf-ogn-275-298 (both isCombatShowdown:false). Required two separate passShowdownFocus rounds to return to neutral-open (inner one conquered the bf, outer one then resolved as a no-op). VP was not double-awarded.
